question: In August 2025, which test marked the successful end-to-end demonstration of the parachute-based deceleration system for the Gaganyaan crew module by ISRO?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-01)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-01)**, conducted in **August 2025**, represented a critical milestone for **ISRO** (Indian Space Research Organisation) by demonstrating the full **parachute-based deceleration system** for the **Gaganyaan** crew module.
 
• This test involved the use of a **Crew Module (CM)** mockup, which was dropped from an altitude of approximately **5 kilometers** using an **Indian Air Force C-130J** transport aircraft.
 
• The primary objective of **IADT-01** was to validate the complex sequence of **ten parachutes** that are essential for slowing down the crew module from high-speed atmospheric re-entry to a safe touchdown speed.
